name: AuthPortal
description: AuthPortal is a lightweight, self-hosted authentication gateway for Plex users. It reproduces Overseerr’s clean popup login (no code entry), stores the Plex token, and issues a secure session cookie for your intranet portal.

variables.name: Database Connection URL
variables.description: Postgres database connection URL

variables.name: App Base URL
variables.description: Public URL of this service. If using HTTPS, cookies will be marked Secure.

variables.name: Trusted Proxy CIDR Ranges
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted proxy CIDR ranges for forwarded headers

variables.name: Media Server
variables.description: Type of media server to authenticate against

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: HMAC secret for JWT cookie

variables.name: Data Key
variables.description: Base64 32-byte key for sealing tokens at rest

variables.name: Force Secure Cookie
variables.description: Set to 1 to force Secure on cookies (behind TLS/ingress)

variables.name: Force HSTS Header
variables.description: Set to 1 to force HSTS headers even if APP_BASE_URL is http (when TLS terminates upstream)

variables.name: Authorized Page - External URL
variables.description: External URL on authorized page

variables.name: Authorized Page - External URL Text
variables.description: Text for external URL on authorized page

variables.name: Unauthorized Page Request - Email
variables.description: Email address for unauthorized page request access link

variables.name: Unauthorized Page Request - Email Subject
variables.description: Subject for unauthorized page request access email

variables.name: Plex - Owner Token
variables.description: Token from Plex server owner; used to validate server membership.

variables.name: Plex - Server Machine ID
variables.description: Machine ID of your Plex server (preferred over name).

variables.name: Plex - Server Name
variables.description: Optional: Plex server name (used if machine ID not set).

variables.name: Emby - Server URL
variables.description: URL of your Emby server (e.g. http://IP:PORT).

variables.name: Emby - Server API Key
variables.description: API key from your Emby server.

variables.name: Emby - App Name
variables.description: Name of the Emby application (for client headers).

variables.name: Emby - App Version
variables.description: Version of the Emby application (for client headers).

variables.name: Jellyfin - Server URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellyfin server (e.g. http://IP:PORT).

variables.name: Jellyfin - Server API Key
variables.description: API key from your Jellyfin server.

variables.name: Jellyfin - App Name
variables.description: Name of the Jellyfin application (for client headers).

variables.name: Jellyfin - App Version
variables.description: Version of the Jellyfin application (for client headers).

variables.name: OIDC Provider - Signing Key
variables.description: PEM-encoded private key for OIDC ID token signing

variables.name: OIDC Provider - Issuer URL
variables.description: Issuer URL for OIDC provider (should match APP_BASE_URL)

variables.name: Trusted Redirect Hosts
variables.description: Optional, comma-separated allow-list for absolute OIDC redirect_uri hosts

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level
